scope: Source trace, official documentation and RevenueCat dashboard review for the App Store privacy label (#17), plus the resulting policy and ASC publication. RevenueCat and Slack state was not changed.

refs.claim: RevenueCat requests use the rc-backup proxy
Configure with API key and UI locale only: no custom App User ID, logIn, attributes, attribution, ATT or diagnostics
iOS 15+ presents RevenueCatUI CustomerCenterView
macOS uses the app-owned PurchaseSupportView (restore, refresh, feedback)
App feedback mailto pre-fills only app name and version
iOS opens the privacy URL in SFSafariViewController
macOS opens the privacy URL in the default browser
In-app help and privacy URLs point to the gewill.org blog posts

revenueCat.checkoutMethod: Temporary shallow fetch of both commit SHAs outside the repository; the Xcode dependency cache was not read or modified
privacyRelevantChanges: SubscriberAttributesManager: $attConsentStatus is also refreshed during attribute sync (foreground, background, login, logout), not only with receipt posts
SubscriptionDetailViewModel.hasActiveSubscription now ignores expired subscriptions; a lifetime non-consumable is still not an active subscription in either version
New workflows endpoint is gated by the -EnableWorkflowsEndpoint launch argument; new RemoteConfigAPI has no caller outside Backend

refs.claim: Default support email body: RC User ID, App Version, Device (UIDevice.model), OS Version, StoreFront Country Code
mailto draft is built from the configured support email
Purchase detail shows the ticket button when tickets are allowed, otherwise a mailto button
mailto button in purchase detail only when the purchase is not from the App Store, or there is no purchase
Ticket visibility follows supportTickets.allowCreation and customerType
Active subscription excludes non-subscription purchases
Restore with no purchases found offers the mailto draft whenever a support email exists and mail can open
Ticket form submits the typed email and description (max 250 characters)
Ticket request body: app_user_id, customer_email, issue_description
Ticket endpoint
Server-side embedded ticket metadata options
Impression tracked when Customer Center appears
No purchases: configured noActive screen, otherwise fallback restore view
Impression event once per view model: locale, dark mode, sandbox flag, display mode
Survey answer event sends the chosen option ID; additionalContext is always nil
Cancel path only for App Store renewable subscriptions
EventsManager is created on iOS 15+ / macOS 12+ when the event store can be created
Customer Center events are queued through EventsManager
Events stored with app user ID and app session ID
Flush on foreground (delayed)
Flush on resign active
Event request fields: id, version, type, app_user_id, app_session_id, timestamp, dark_mode, locale, is_sandbox, display_mode, revision_id
Feature events default host api-paywalls.revenuecat.com
A configured proxy URL replaces the host for every path
Default headers: platform, OS version, device model, app version/build, bundle ID, preferred locales, storefront, sandbox and debug flags, installation method
X-Apple-Device-Identifier header carries identifierForVendor
identifierForVendor: UIDevice IDFV on iOS; on macOS only in sandbox (MAC-derived UUID)
$idfa/$idfv/$ip attributes only via collectDeviceIdentifiers
$attConsentStatus is set from the current ATT status
Automatic identifier collection runs only when an attribution network ID is set
Diagnostics disabled by default
Workflows endpoint gated by launch argument

officialDocs.usedFor: Collect definition, optional disclosure criteria, data types, purposes, linked data, tracking, IP address and web view guidance

Purchase History required with App Functionality and Analytics; linked when the App User ID can be tied to contact info; Device ID only for advertising-identifier integrations; no location collection claimed

Support email optional; Contact Support visibility defaults to customers without an active subscription; in-app tickets replace the email handoff when Contact support metadata is enabled; embedded metadata options; survey responses chart
$attConsentStatus populated without an ATT prompt; device identifiers are reserved attributes
Dashboard country uses transaction country, else last-seen IP country; IP address is not persisted after the country is determined
Slack notifications downstream of purchase events

publicPages.method: Anonymous HTTP GET; external <script src> hosts only

notRead: Slack integration detail and event history
